name: James Hook
source:
Captain of the pirate ship in Neverland. He holds a grudge against [url=/c12558]Peter Pan[/url] for severing his arm off, and he fears the Watch Crocodile who ate that arm. He also detests [url=/c12557]Scissor[/url] who thinks of that incident as entertainment.

His appearance and behaviour are atrocious, but contrary to his barbaric image, he’s very particular about etiquette. He like the scent of chocolate, and of course the taste of it as well. He has a pet parrot, Jewel, who always sits on his shoulders.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
